notes: him is given to the substantival article τόν under rule 32 and the resumptive τοῦτον is left unrepresented; the reverse assignment remains defensible and is named in the unit's note.

συνελθόντα keeps only its verb word because the expressed dative αὐτοῖς carries with them as its case government, while συμπαραλαμβάνειν keeps with them for the preverb where no dative stands; rule 106 both ways.
